### Patch Changes

- [#1451](https://github.com/millionco/react-doctor/pull/1451) [`4fbab2d`](https://github.com/millionco/react-doctor/commit/4fbab2ddc8a3e808afe90a291325b4da0f7817ab) Thanks [@aidenybai](https://github.com/aidenybai)! - Detect TanStack Start root documents that omit client scripts and unsafe filesystem containment checks that compare resolved paths with a bare string prefix.

readmeHtml:
Your agent writes bad React, this catches it.

React Doctor deterministically scans your codebase and finds issues across state & effects, performance, architecture, security, and accessibility.

Works for all React frameworks and libraries - Next.js, Vite, TanStack, React Native, Expo, you name it.

Scans JavaScript and TypeScript source files plus JavaScript in standard inline <script> blocks in .html files.

Website →

Install

1. Quick start

Run this at your project root to get an audit.

npx react-doctor@latest
Main.mp4

2. Install for agents

Once you have an audit, you can install the skill for your coding agent to learn from the issues and fix them in the future.

npx react-doctor@latest install

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and many more.

3. Run in CI

React Doctor reviews every pull request and reports only the issues your change introduced, not your existing backlog. Set it up with one command:

npx react-doctor@latest ci install

This adds the workflow, scans every pull request, and posts a summary comment. Change the gate, scan scope, and comments anytime with react-doctor ci config, and bump the action with react-doctor ci upgrade. GitHub Actions is fully supported; GitLab CI gets a gate-only scaffold.

CI docs →

4. Configure rules

You can configure which rules to run and how to run them in doctor.config.ts.

Learn more →

Telemetry

The CLI reports crashes, basic run traces, and anonymous usage counters to Sentry to help us fix bugs and prioritize work.

We collect:

  • Environment: CLI version, platform, Node version
  • Invocation: which command, package manager, and run context (whether it's local vs. CI vs. coding agent)
  • Project shape: framework, React version, TypeScript, project size (NO file contents)
  • Rules fired: rule names and counts only (e.g. react-doctor/no-array-index-as-key) (NO code or specific findings)
  • De-minified React Doctor CLI stack traces

To opt out, run: npx react-doctor@latest --no-telemetry

Contributing

Issues welcome!

aiSummary.oneLiner: A deterministic CLI tool that audits React codebases for state, performance, architectural, and security issues.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: React Doctor scans JavaScript and TypeScript source files to identify suboptimal patterns in React applications. It acts as an automated reviewer, finding deterministic issues related to state management, side effects, performance bottlenecks, and accessibility. Designed to work across any React framework including Next.js, Vite, and React Native, it can even inspect inline script blocks in HTML files. It integrates directly into CI pipelines to review pull requests, reporting only new regressions rather than backlog issues.
keyFeatures: Deterministic Scanning: Analyzes your codebase for concrete, proven issues across multiple architectural domains.
Framework Agnostic: Seamlessly works with Next.js, Vite, TanStack, React Native, and Expo without extra setup.
CI Pipeline Integration: Reviews pull requests and posts a summary comment highlighting only newly introduced problems.
Agent Skill Mode: Provides an installable skill allowing coding agents to learn from issues and fix them autonomously.
Inline Script Inspection: Capable of parsing and scanning JavaScript embedded directly within standard HTML files.
Opt-out Telemetry: Provides transparent, anonymous usage reporting with a simple flag to disable it entirely.

useCases.title: Automated pull request reviews
useCases.description: Engineering teams can catch React anti-patterns in CI before they merge into the main branch, reducing technical debt.

useCases.title: Performance bottleneck detection
useCases.description: Frontend developers can proactively discover state and effect loops that cause unnecessary re-renders.

useCases.title: Coding agent enhancement
useCases.description: AI agent operators can install the React Doctor skill, teaching tools like Claude Code and Cursor to write cleaner React.

useCases.title: Accessibility compliance auditing
useCases.description: QA engineers can scan codebases for missing ARIA attributes and structural accessibility flaws directly from the terminal.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: React Doctor is tailored for frontend developers, engineering managers, and AI coding agent operators who want to maintain high code quality standards. It assumes familiarity with React fundamentals and Node.js environments.
